raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is to write the vacuum adjudication's measured sign verdicts into imas_ambix/data/maps/jt-60sa/magnetics.json without writing any rule the adjudication did not measure; the diff does exactly that. The 16 median-rule identity probes (magPbTC1..16) take channel_factor +1 and flux loop 7 takes -1, all moved to validation_state corpus-validated with evidence citing the median slope, the median |r| and the three shots; the 27 undecided channels (loops 1-27 bar 7, plus magPbTC17) stay source-only at channel_factor 1 with the adjudication's own reason verbatim; the Ip rule (magnetics/ip/data) and jt-60sa.json are untouched. A programmatic cross-check of every authored verdict against docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-adjudication.json found 0 mismatches (factor, state, cited slope/|r|, shots, reason).
VERDICT done_when: the plan names writing the measured verdicts, keeping the sign on the pulse rule's channel_factor (every rule one_like with no source COCOS), moving each adjudicated rule's validation_state, and not adding a FluxLoopPositionDeclaration to jt-60sa.json. The map shows 45 rules: 17 corpus-validated (16 probes +1, magFlxLp7 -1) and 28 source-only; the commit touches only the three declared paths, so jt-60sa.json gains no declaration. The named gate passes 37 passed EXIT=0.
VERDICT write_paths: the fence lists imas_ambix/data/maps/jt-60sa/magnetics.json, tests/data/test_jt60sa_signal_maps.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-verdicts-author.html and a figures dir; git show --name-only 755c4b09 touches only the first three, so the diff is inside the declared scope and no figure is written.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records commit 755c4b09, both arms and the negative control with log paths, the receipt it copies from, and no blockers. Its baseline_suite/after_suite JSON agree with the cited logs (35 passed and 37 passed, 0 failures each). Two blemishes: its tests field quotes '37 passed in 7.29s' where gate.log records '37 passed in 19.04s' (count and EXIT agree, duration disagrees), and baseline-arm.log's header module-probe raised TypeError so that log carries no module_under_test line.
VERDICT diff: read against base 3d54ae6f (git rev-list base..head count 1). magnetics.json rewrites the evidence of the 44 adjudicated rules and flips loop 7's channel_factor to -1.0 and its validation_state to corpus-validated (plus the 16 probes' state); loops 1-27 bar 7 and probe 17 keep channel_factor 1.0 and carry the adjudication reason; the Ip rule is unchanged. test_jt60sa_signal_maps.py adds two guards (test_magnetics_authors_the_vacuum_sign_verdicts pins the 17 measured and requires slope/|r|/shots; test_magnetics_leaves_the_undecided_channels_source_only requires the receipt's reason verbatim), relaxes two strict source-only assertions to the known vocabulary, and repurposes the all-source-only test. The fragment records the landing and the target convention (COCOS 17, DD 4.1.1).
VERDICT adjudication_fidelity: every authored verdict reproduces the receipt it cites -- the receipt gives verdict_counts identity 16, negate 1, undecided 27 over shots 100579/100595/100642, and the map's 44 adjudicated rules carry exactly those verdicts with the receipt's median slope, median |r| and reason string; the test reads the receipt at docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-adjudication.json rather than hard-coding numbers, so a future divergence fails the guard.
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the plan's jtmm-vacuum-verdicts-author paragraph names exactly this authoring: +1 for identity, -1 for loop 7's negate, corpus-validated with evidence citing median slope/|r|/shots, and the 27 undecided channels source-only at 1 with the adjudication reason; the map carries all of it (0 mismatches against the receipt) and correctly adds no FluxLoopPositionDeclaration to jt-60sa.json.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate.log (37 passed, EXIT=0, revision 755c4b09, tree, module_under_test) and baseline-arm.log (35 passed, EXIT=0, revision 3d54ae6f, tree, cwd) bracket the change with named ids and revisions; negative-control.log shows the declared mutation (loop 7 channel_factor -> 1) failing test_magnetics_authors_the_vacuum_sign_verdicts at 'assert 1.0 == -1.0' with EXIT=1, an id the head arm does not fail. Two blemishes keep it below full: the manifest's tests field quotes a run duration (7.29s) that disagrees with the gate.log it cites (19.04s), and baseline-arm.log's header probe raised a TypeError so the base arm names no module_under_test path.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git show --name-only 755c4b09 lists only magnetics.json, test_jt60sa_signal_maps.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the fence; no figure directory, no plan, sprint or index file is touched; the manifest's changed_paths match the diff exactly.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: two guards are added and the negative control proves one of them fires -- setting loop 7's channel_factor back to 1 fails test_magnetics_authors_the_vacuum_sign_verdicts, which passes at head. The evidence-citation guard and the undecided-reason guard have no separate refusal demonstrated, so only one of the three new refusals is shown to fire.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change keeps the existing SignalRule schema and the validation_state vocabulary, leaves the sign on channel_factor as the plan's signal-rule carrier, writes the evidence in the surrounding style, and the commit carries a conventional subject and a mechanism body; the evidence fragment follows the plan-evidence fragment conventions.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: no new abstraction or module is added; the new guards read the adjudication receipt directly rather than restating its numbers, the verdicts are copied into the existing rules rather than a parallel store, and the 45-rule map's shape is unchanged.
